key_points_wrong: Says cmd 2>&1 > file produces the same result as cmd > file 2>&1 -- this is WRONG. In cmd 2>&1 > file, stderr goes to the terminal (original stdout) and only stdout goes to file
brief_justification: Critical error: cmd 2>&1 > file does NOT send both streams to file. stderr is redirected to stdout FIRST (which is still the terminal), then stdout is redirected to file. So stderr goes to terminal and stdout goes to file.
